answer: Because the timing is entered against the shale challenge, the sonnet audit can replay the vault history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 173 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4848 identities would post 2892 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
